These streams are channeled into distinct, navigable canyons, manifesting as tightly clustered ribbons of glowing light. Each ribbon is defined by razor-sharp, crystalline edges. Adding to the spectacle, the edges of the entire flow exhibit a constant, visible harmonic oscillation, creating a field of luminous energy that weaves through the subterranean depths.
